summary: Tested Frequently Bought Together (FBT) feature on Product Detail Page and Cart Drawer. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: PDP shows FBT section with source product ('This Item' badge), 3 recommended products with checkboxes, bundle summary with total/savings, 'Add X to Cart' button. Toggle selection works (deselecting updates count/price). Cart Drawer shows compact FBT section with '+ Add' buttons that correctly filter out items already in cart.

issues: One product ('Top') shows broken/missing image thumbnail - likely missing product image in database

action_items: Consider adding fallback/placeholder image for products without images in FBT sections
critical_code_review_comments: product_routes.py: FBT endpoint correctly implements 3-step fallback (co-purchase → same-category → popular)
product_routes.py: FBT endpoint correctly excludes source product from results
product_routes.py: FBT endpoint returns all required fields (product_id, name, price, compare_price, images, sizes, colors, stock)
FrequentlyBoughtTogether.jsx: BundleProductCard correctly shows 'This Item' badge on source product
FrequentlyBoughtTogether.jsx: Checkbox toggle correctly updates selectedIds state and recalculates bundle total
FrequentlyBoughtTogether.jsx: handleAddAll correctly adds source product + selected FBT products to cart
FrequentlyBoughtTogether.jsx: FrequentlyBoughtTogetherCompact correctly filters out items already in cart
CartDrawer.jsx: Compact FBT section integrated at line 425 with cartItems prop
context_for_next_testing_agent: FBT feature fully tested. PDP at /product/{product_id} shows FBT section below product details. Cart Drawer shows compact FBT when cart has items. FBT endpoint uses 3-step fallback: co-purchased products → same-category → popular by sold_count. Compact FBT filters out items already in cart. Test product: prod_2636c2324d48.
